eligibility.title: Structured eligibility (“My 10 scholarships” test)
eligibility.intro: The test reads these rules, not the free text above. A rule only rules a student out when its impact is “Exclusion”, the conditions were verified less than 400 days ago and the student confirmed their answer. When in doubt, the scholarship stays “to check”.
eligibility.neverStamped: Conditions never verified: no rule rules anyone out yet.
eligibility.catalogWarning: This entry comes from the repository catalogue: the repository is the source of truth. On the next reconcile its content replaces these fields, unless your “Conditions verified” stamp is newer than the repository's. Make the fix in the repository too.
eligibility.countriesLoadError: The country list could not be loaded: country search is unavailable, codes already entered are still shown.
eligibility.countrySearchPlaceholder: Search a country (name or ISO3 code)…
eligibility.fieldsScopeHint: “Listed fields” uses the entry's related fields. A field never rules anyone out: at worst, “to check”.
eligibility.fieldsListedEmptyHint: “Listed fields” but no related field: fill in the entry's fields, otherwise this choice has no effect.
eligibility.criteriaEmpty: No criteria: the scholarship will at best be “to check”.
eligibility.impactHint: “Exclusion” can rule a student out (nationality, age, experience only); “To check” flags a point without ruling out; “Information” is only quoted.
eligibility.impactHardNeverExcludesHint: This criterion type never rules anyone out: as “Exclusion” it is treated as “To check”.
eligibility.anyNationalityHint: “Any nationality” semantics: “Open” passes if ANY of the student's nationalities is listed; “Closed” rules the student out if ANY of them is (a French dual national is ruled out of Eiffel).
eligibility.maxInclusiveHint: Checked: “29 at most” (29 accepted). Unchecked: “under 30” (30 refused).
eligibility.asOfHint: Without an exact date (estimated session or “not specified”), a student within 12 months of the limit stays “to check”.
eligibility.waivableLabel: Requirement can be waived by the organisation
eligibility.languageHint: Language never rules anyone out: an insufficient level gives “to check”. Only English and French are compared with the profile.
eligibility.financialNeedHint: Always “Information”: financial need is not asked in the test.
eligibility.otherHint: A condition the test cannot read: the student will see it as “to check”.
eligibility.stampHint: “Conditions verified” saves this content and stamps it in your name (logged). The stamp lasts 400 days.
eligibility.dirtyStampedHint: Saving modified content without re-verifying it removes the stamp: the entry becomes a draft again.
eligibility.stampSuccess: Conditions verified: content saved and stamped.
eligibility.unstampSuccess: Verification removed: the entry is a draft.
eligibility.formHasErrors: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.
eligibility.error_invalid_key: Key: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (64 characters at most).
eligibility.error_duplicate_key: This key is already used by another criterion.
eligibility.error_invalid_source_url: An http(s) source URL is required.
eligibility.error_unknown_country: A country code is not in the ISO table.
eligibility.error_missing_age_bound: Enter a minimum or a maximum age.
eligibility.error_inverted_age_bounds: The minimum age is above the maximum age.
eligibility.error_missing_language_requirement: Enter a CEFR level or at least one test.
eligibility.error_levels_required: Tick at least one level before marking the conditions as verified.

parrainage.leaderboardNote: Qualified = account created during the campaign, email verified, profile completed, code entered during the campaign. “To review” does not count until the team validates it. Click a row for details.
parrainage.excludeReasonPrompt: Reason for exclusion (required, kept in the audit trail):
parrainage.validateReasonPrompt: Why is this signal legitimate? (optional, e.g. “school workshop, same Wi-Fi”)

participant.minorHint: Minor or unknown age: not ranked and no prize until the signed parental authorisation is verified. A minor's prize is paid to the parent.

flag.ip_burst: Burst from the same IP address
flag.ip_block_burst: Burst from the same network range

parrainage.activateHint: The account must exist in the app. Approval creates their ambassador code and personal code; both count. No “commissions” space in the app.
parrainage.podiumNotValidated: The podium is validated once the campaign is frozen. Current leaderboard preview:
parrainage.payoutHint: Manual Wave payout: record the transaction reference and the date. For a minor, the recipient is the parent.
parrainage.settingsLocked: Campaign launched: only names and rules can still change.
parrainage.forfeit: Declare the prize forfeited and reassign
parrainage.forfeitHint: {name} loses prize #{rank} (rules: unreachable or without payout details 15 days after validation). The prize goes to the next ranked participant who has no prize yet; prizes already paid do not move; the public ranking keeps the real order. Logged, no undo in the tool.
parrainage.forfeitReasonPlaceholder: E.g. unreachable since 18/11 (3 calls, 2 WhatsApp messages)

communityAdmin.title: Community
communityAdmin.subtitle: Moderation, content and settings of the peer-support community.
communityAdmin.reasonPlaceholder: E.g. WhatsApp number and agent fee request.

soon.title: This part is coming soon
soon.body: The server does not offer this feature yet. Nothing to fix on your side.

queue.emptyBody: No hidden or reported content to review.
queue.urgencyHint: Scam or contact details +5, serious report +4, each report +1 (max 5), minor author +2, over 24 h +3.
queue.memberReportsHint: Member report: it hides nothing. A sanction closes their open reports; otherwise, dismiss them.

history.title: Author history
history.summary: {posts} post(s), {replies} visible reply(ies) · {reports} open report(s) · {sanctions} sanction(s)

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.body: Each action opens a confirmation with a reason: no shortcut acts on its own. Disabled while typing.

restore.title: Restore {target}?
restore.body: The content becomes visible to everyone again. Open reports are dismissed.

hide.title: Hide {target}?
hide.body: Only its author will still see it, marked as hidden by moderation. Open reports are actioned.

delete.title: Delete {target}?
delete.body: The content disappears for everyone (kept 30 days for the team, then purged). Open reports are actioned.

dismiss_reports.title: Dismiss the reports on {target}?
dismiss_reports.body: The status does not change, except a hide caused only by the report threshold, which is lifted.

sanction.hideContent: Also hide all their visible content

warning.title: Warn {member}?
warning.body: No restriction: the member gets a notification with your reason.

read_only.title: Make {member} read-only?
read_only.body: The member can read but cannot post, reply or react for the chosen duration.

ban.title: Ban {member}?
ban.body: No end date, until the team lifts it. The member can read but no longer write.

memberReports.title: Dismiss the reports against {member}?
memberReports.body: Open reports against this member are dismissed, with no sanction. Reports on their content are handled per content.

verify.done: Answer marked as verified (any previous one loses the mark).

teamReply.title: Reply on behalf of the team
teamReply.hint: Never filtered. Notifies the author and followers. Friendly tone, no admission promise.
teamReply.asAdvisor: KPB advisor (your first name and initial)
teamReply.placeholder: Mention a record with @[Label](scholarship:id) if useful.
teamReply.verified: Mark as verified by KPB right away

teamPost.title: Team post
teamPost.mentionHint: Mentions: @[Label](type:id), type = scholarship, country, institution or program. Hashtags: #CampusFrance.
teamPost.pinned: Pin at the top of the feed (3 at most)

members.lookupHint: Public member id (cm_…), shown in the queue and discussions.
members.mostReportedHint: Members with open reports, most reported first.
members.sanctionsHint: Read-only and bans not lifted nor expired; “All” includes warnings, lifted and expired ones.
members.summary: {posts} post(s) · {replies} reply(ies) · {helpful} helpful answer(s) · {reports} open report(s)

settings.domainsHint: A link outside the list hides the message pending review. The {n} official catalogue sites (schools, scholarships) are added.
settings.termsHint: On top of the {n} built-in terms (insults, scams). Matched without accents or case, as whole words.
settings.testHint: Paste a message to see what would hide it. Nothing is saved.
settings.fixedHint: Set on the server for now (read-only); editing them from the console is coming soon.

fixed.reportsBeforeHide: Reports from distinct members before temporary hiding
fixed.newAccount: An account counts as new for

dashboard.moderationDelayHint: Auto-hidden content → first decision; target < {h} h
dashboard.unansweredHint: No reply from another member or the team (snapshot).

errors.reasonTooLong: Reason too long (500 characters at most).
errors.bodyTooLong: Reply too long (3,000 characters at most).
errors.domainInvalid: Invalid domain: bare host (univ-lyon1.fr) or suffix (*.univ-lyon1.fr).
errors.unavailable: This feature is not available on the server yet.
errors.forbidden: Your role does not allow this action.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests: try again in a moment.
errors.server: The server did not respond. Try again.
errors.community_pin_limit: Already 3 pinned posts: unpin one first.
errors.community_invalid_transition: Action not possible in the content's current state (e.g. deleted by its author, or reply not visible).
errors.community_invalid_mention: Invalid mention: unknown or non-public entity.
errors.community_bot_draft_not_found: Draft not found (deleted with its post?).
errors.community_bot_draft_obsolete: This draft is out of date (post hidden or facts changed). Regenerate it.

bot.selectBody: The question, the facts with their sources and the proposed text show here.
bot.llmOn: AI rewording on (checked against the facts).
bot.emptyBody: The bot has prepared nothing in this category.

modeHint.review: The bot prepares, the team publishes. Nothing goes out without a click.
modeHint.auto: The bot publishes high-confidence drafts with complete, fresh facts on its own; the rest waits for the team.
modeHint.off: No detection: the queue stays readable, nothing new comes in.

stats.title: Bot statistics
stats.window: Over {days} days: {auto} auto-published, {verified} published as a verified answer.

reason.entity_not_public: Entity not in the public catalogue
reason.post_not_visible: The post is no longer visible
reason.facts_changed: The catalogue facts changed since the draft was written

bot.question: Question
bot.incomplete: Incomplete facts or to be re-checked
bot.factsHint: Taken from the published catalogue. Links open the official sources.
bot.textHint: {n} / {max} characters. Keep dates and sources as they are.
bot.donePublishedVerified: Answer published and marked “Verified by KPB”.
bot.rejectBody: Nothing is published. The reason stays in the bot history.

modeHint.shadow: The bot spots needs and applies every safeguard, but sends nothing: “Simulated sends” shows what the active mode would have sent.
modeHint.on: The bot sends a private notification pointing to the app feature, then WhatsApp. Roll back: KPB_ASSIST_BRIDGE_MODE=shadow.
modeHint.off: No detection, nothing sent. Past events stay readable.

stats.title: Bridge bot statistics
stats.window: Events created over the last {days} days, by need.

assistBridge.eventsHint: No student identity. An excerpt only shows for public community content; never for the coach.
assistBridge.emptyBody: The bot has not spotted any need for these filters yet.
assistBridge.coachPrivate: Private message to the coach: no text is kept or shown.
assistBridge.noExcerpt: Content no longer visible: no excerpt.
assistBridge.catalogHint: Patterns, target features and sent texts live in the code (assist-bridge.rules.ts). Changing them requires a new version.
assistBridge.catalogMeta: Version {version} · at least {words} words per message
